name: dsh-desktop
description: DeepSeek Harness 的非官方 Windows 桌面发行版
author: Dr1empty

scripts.dist:desktop: npm run prepare:desktop && electron-builder --config electron-builder-desktop.yml --publish never
scripts.dist:desktop-installer: npm run dist:desktop && electron-builder --win nsis --prepackaged "dist-desktop/win-unpacked" --config electron-builder-desktop-installer.yml --publish never
scripts.release:desktop: npm run dist:desktop-installer && npm run release:metadata
